server.name: io.github.chrischall/signupgenius-mcp
server.description: SignUpGenius for Claude — sign-ups, slots, groups, and RSVPs. Free accounts or Pro API key.

environmentVariables.description: SignUpGenius login email (recommended). Pair with SIGNUPGENIUS_PASSWORD for session mode — works on free accounts. No SSO/2FA.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: SignUpGenius password (recommended) — required iff SIGNUPGENIUS_EMAIL is set.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: SignUpGenius Pro API key (Pro Tools > API Management). Required only for slot REPORTS — Pro subscription needed.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_USER_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Override the default JSON API base (v2/k for key mode, v3 for session mode).
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Session mode only: override the host for legacy /SUGboxAPI.cfm calls. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_LEGACY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Session mode only: override the login-form host. Defaults to https://www.signupgenius.com.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_LOGIN_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip the fetchproxy browser-extension fallback (missing creds become a hard error — useful in headless CI).
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_SESSION_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.signupgenius-mcp/session.json.
environmentVariables.name: SIGNUPGENIUS_SESSION_FILE

server.name: io.github.chrischall/skylight-mcp
server.description: Skylight Calendar for Claude — family events, chores, and rewards.

environmentVariables.description: An OAuth refresh token you already hold. Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Skylight account email. Pair with SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD for direct login. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Skylight account password — required iff SKYLIGHT_EMAIL is set. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Optional: pick a specific Skylight frame when the account has more than one.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_FRAME_ID

environmentVariables.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.skylight-mcp/tokens.json.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base (default https://app.ourskylight.com/api). The auth origin is derived from it, so pointing this elsewhere moves the login flow too — and the new host must be added to the registration’s egress allowlist, or every call is blocked.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Skylight account email. Pair with SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD for direct login. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Skylight account password — required iff SKYLIGHT_EMAIL is set. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Optional: pick a specific Skylight frame when the account has more than one.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_FRAME_ID

environmentVariables.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_CACHE

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.skylight-mcp/tokens.json.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_TOKEN_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Override the API base (default https://app.ourskylight.com/api). The auth origin is derived from it, so pointing this elsewhere moves the login flow too — and the new host must be added to the registration’s egress allowlist, or every call is blocked.
environmentVariables.name: SKYLIGHT_BASE_URL
